xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3154: A merge to main silently invalidates open branches: no agent is notified when its base stops applying

plan.title: A merge to main silently invalidates open branches: no agent is notified when its base stops applying
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: A merge to main silently invalidates open branches: nothing detects that a live agent's base stopped applying until the merge gate, so agents keep building on invalid bases and one merge quietly creates N stalled branches. On 2026-07-26 merge 6ac4a3dc11 (PAN-3116) invalidated three live branches and none were notified for 12+ minutes.
narratives.Proposal: Add a branch-invalidation sweep to the deacon patrol: watch each project's origin/main head (ls-remote, 120s cooldown, last-seen SHA in app_settings); on change, probe every in-pipeline issue's workspace with git merge-tree; mark newly-conflicting branches with a merge_conflict blocker plus a new conflictsSince {sha, detectedAt, paths} review-status field; notify the live owning agent via resolveIssueFeedbackTarget + messageAgent naming the commit and paths; emit a summary activity entry per sweep; clear conflictsSince in the conflict gate's existing clean path.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No automatic rebase of agents' branches (detect, mark, notify only)
- No change to merge-train eligibility or the merge_train.enabled default
- No polyrepo multi-repo probing (primary workspace repo only)
- No dedicated dashboard badge for conflictsSince (blockerReasons/stuckReason already render; field lands in API DTO + durable record)
- No backfill for merges that landed before this ships
- No change to webhook blocker handling (additive; dedupes via conflictsSince.sha)

autoDecisions.summary: Detect via a deacon-patrol main-head watcher (ls-remote per project, 120s cooldown) instead of hooking firePostMergeLifecycle
autoDecisions.rationale: firePostMergeLifecycle misses webhook admin merges (webhook-handlers.ts:423 calls postMergeLifecycle directly) and out-of-band pushes; keying on the remote ref moving covers every merge path with one mechanism. The issue's fix direction 1 ('on merge to main, evaluate every open PR') is satisfied by reacting to the observable effect — main moved — within ~2 minutes.

autoDecisions.summary: Mark invalidated branches with the existing merge_conflict blockerReason plus a new conflictsSince field, rather than a parallel marker
autoDecisions.rationale: A blocker flips readyForMerge and routes the issue into the existing conflict gate, review-dispatch defer, resolver dispatch, and cockpit stuckReason display for free; conflictsSince carries what blockers cannot (causing SHA + paths), which is the issue's fix direction 3.

autoDecisions.summary: Notify via resolveIssueFeedbackTarget + messageAgent, deduped per main head SHA; skip silently when no live agent
autoDecisions.rationale: The feedback-target resolver handles swarm slots and unregistered slots; stopped agents are already covered by the existing conflict-resolver dispatch, so a second nudge channel would duplicate it.

autoDecisions.summary: Sweep-local workspace resolution (agents-table workspace column, then workspaces/feature-<issue>* prefix scan)
autoDecisions.rationale: getWorkspaceInfoForIssue (routes/workspaces.ts:411) misses feature-<issue>-strike and -slot-N directories and lives in a route module; the PAN-3150 victim was a strike branch, so missing -strike workspaces would fail the issue's own repro.
The issue asks for detection + notification so the rebase happens early; the owning agent rebases with full context. Auto-rebasing a mid-work branch would race the agent's uncommitted state.

items.title: Add probeBranchConflictPaths returning conflicting paths to the conflict gate

expected_outputs: conflict-gate.test.ts passes including the new probeBranchConflictPaths parse fixtures

narrative.Action: In src/lib/cloister/conflict-gate.ts, add an exported probeBranchConflictPaths(workspacePath, targetBranch, deps?) returning Promise<{ mergeability: BranchMergeability; paths: string[] }>, using the same fetch + `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only HEAD origin/<target>` invocation as checkBranchMergeability (lines 77-105). Parse rule (verified experimentally, see PRD): exit 0 → { mergeability: 'clean', paths: [] }; exit 1 → { mergeability: 'conflicts', paths: <stdout lines after the tree-OID first line, up to the first blank line> }; any other failure (fatal/usage in output, fetch failure) → { mergeability: 'unknown', paths: [] }, matching mergeTreeFailureIndicatesConflict semantics (lines 330-340). Export the path extraction as a pure function (e.g. parseMergeTreeNameOnly(stdout)) for unit tests. Reimplement checkBranchMergeability as a thin wrapper over probeBranchConflictPaths (behavior-preserving — same tri-state results) so there is one probe implementation. Extend tests/unit/lib/cloister/conflict-gate.test.ts with fake-exec fixtures using the exact strings from the PRD's verified git output: conflict case returns { mergeability: 'conflicts', paths: ['a.txt'] }; a 3-file conflict returns all 3 paths in order; clean case returns { mergeability: 'clean', paths: [] }; fatal output returns 'unknown'. All git I/O stays async (execAsync pattern, 30s timeout, no execSync).

items.title: Given a merge-tree exit 1 fixture with one conflicting file, probeBranchConflictPaths returns mergeability 'conflicts' and paths ['a.txt']
Given a merge-tree exit 1 fixture with three conflicting files, the probe returns all three paths in output order
Given a merge-tree exit 0 fixture, the probe returns mergeability 'clean' and an empty paths array
Given a fatal/usage failure or failed fetch, the probe returns mergeability 'unknown' and checkBranchMergeability keeps its current tri-state behavior (existing tests stay green)

Add reconcileBranchInvalidation deacon patrol sweep that marks branches invalidated by a main-head move

expected_outputs: branch-invalidation.test.ts passes covering unchanged-SHA no-op, changed-SHA fan-out, dedup, unknown/ls-remote failure, and strike/slot workspace resolution
typecheck and lint complete without errors

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/branch-invalidation.ts exporting reconcileBranchInvalidation(): Promise<string[]> (action strings, deacon convention) with injectable deps for tests. Behavior: (1) group in-pipeline issues (loadReviewStatuses(), mergeStatus !== 'merged') by project via resolveProjectFromIssueSync (deacon-merge.ts:449 precedent). (2) Per project on a 120s in-memory cooldown (same shape as staleMergeBlockerCooldowns in deacon-merge.ts), run `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` in the project root (async exec, 30s timeout — no execSync); compare with getSetting('branch_invalidation.main_head.<projectKey>'); unchanged → skip; failure → skip and keep last-seen. (3) On change, for each issue of that project resolve the workspace: the agents-table workspace column (listAllAgentsSync, src/lib/overdeck/agents.ts:1000) if set and existing, else the first existing directory matching <projectPath>/workspaces/feature-<issueLower>* (prefix covers -strike/-slot-N); skip when none exists. (4) Probe with conflict-path-probe's probeBranchConflictPaths(workspacePath, 'main'): conflicts AND existing.conflictsSince?.sha !== newSha → setReviewStatusSync with conflictsSince {sha, detectedAt, paths} and blockerReasons replacing prior merge blockers with { type: 'merge_conflict', summary: 'Conflicts with main since <sha7> (<n> path[s]): <first 3 paths comma-joined>', detectedAt } while keeping non-merge blockers (replace pattern from webhook-handlers.ts:482-498), plus a per-issue warn activity entry via emitActivityEntrySync; clean → no write; unknown → no write. (5) After each changed project's sweep, setSetting the new SHA and, if any issues were newly marked, emit ONE summary activity entry (source 'cloister', level 'warn'): 'main <sha7> invalidated N branch(es): <issue ids comma-joined>'. (6) In src/lib/cloister/conflict-gate.ts resolveConflictGate clean path (lines 167-176), add conflictsSince: undefined to the same setReviewStatus write that clears blockers. Wire reconcileBranchInvalidation() into runPatrol in src/lib/cloister/deacon.ts immediately after the reconcileStaleMergeBlockers block (lines 3101-3108), following the exact `const xActions = await …; actions.push(...); for (const a of …) addLog('action', a, state.patrolCycle);` pattern with the neighbors' try/catch convention. FILE-SIZE RATCHET: src/lib/cloister/deacon.ts is at its scripts/file-size-baseline.txt cap (3605 = 3605) and the patrol wiring grows it — bump the deacon.ts baseline entry to the new line count in the SAME commit (manual audited edit per scripts/lint-file-size.sh rule D4; cite PAN-3154 in the commit message; do not use --update). The new branch-invalidation.ts must stay ≤1000 lines (new-file ceiling). Tests in tests/unit/lib/cloister/branch-invalidation.test.ts with injected deps (status map, ls-remote result, probe result, setReviewStatus, settings store, activity emitter, now) assert: unchanged SHA → zero probes; changed SHA → only that project's issues probed; newly-conflicting issue gets conflictsSince + replaced merge blocker + one summary entry; same SHA on a second run → no second mark; unknown probe and ls-remote failure → zero writes; workspace resolution prefers the agents-table workspace and falls back to the feature-<issue>* prefix scan matching -strike/-slot-N dirs.

items.title: When the stored main head is unchanged, the sweep skips workspace probing and produces zero writes; when origin/main moves, the sweep probes every in-pipeline issue of that project with a workspace within one run

A newly-conflicting issue's review status records conflictsSince.sha equal to the new main head, the probed paths, a merge_conflict blocker replacing prior merge blockers (non-merge blockers preserved), and readyForMerge false
Running the sweep twice against the same main head marks and reports each issue exactly once (dedup via conflictsSince.sha)
A probe result of 'unknown' or an ls-remote failure produces zero state writes, zero activity entries, and preserves the stored main head SHA
When a branch becomes mergeable again, resolveConflictGate's clean path updates the record to remove both the merge blockers and conflictsSince in one write (FR-6 test in conflict-gate.test.ts)
Notify the live owning agent with the causing commit and conflicting paths

expected_outputs: notification tests pass: live target messaged once with sha+paths, needsYou target skipped, same-SHA resweep does not re-message

narrative.Action: In src/lib/cloister/branch-invalidation.ts add notifyBranchInvalidated(issueId, info: { sha: string; paths: string[] }) and call it from reconcileBranchInvalidation for each newly-marked issue. Use resolveIssueFeedbackTarget(issueId) from src/lib/cloister/feedback-target.ts (verification-runner.ts:218-224 precedent): if the result is needsYou, skip silently (stopped agents are covered by the blocker + existing conflict-resolver dispatch — do NOT build a second nudge channel); otherwise messageAgent(target.agentId, message, 'internal') with: 'main moved: merge <sha7> now conflicts with your branch in: <paths comma-joined>. Rebase onto the new main NOW while the conflict is small — run `pan sync-main <ISSUE>` (or `git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main`), resolve preserving BOTH intents, then continue your current task.' Dedup is structural (the sweep only calls this when conflictsSince.sha !== newSha) — one notification per main head per issue. Extend branch-invalidation.test.ts: live target → messageAgent called once and the message contains the sha and every conflicting path; needsYou target → no call and no throw; second sweep with the same SHA → no second call.
